card.name: Cisplatin eligibility and patient-group wording
card.fires_on: The end of 'cisplatin' or the hyphen after it in 'cisplatin-eligible/ineligible', plus small words like 'are' or 'in' inside phrases naming patient groups (e.g. 'Patients who are...', 'platinum-resistant'). Seen in oncology dosing sections.

modes.label: Cisplatin eligibility
modes.description: The final part of 'cisplatin' or the hyphen in 'cisplatin-eligible' or 'cisplatin-ineligible' headings.
modes.example: Patients who are cispl<<atin>>-eligible Cisplatin inelig

modes.label: Linking words in patient groups
modes.description: Small words such as 'Are', 'are' or 'in' leading into a patient-group or indication phrase.
modes.example: for Patients Who<< Are>> Ineligible for ASCT Use the dos

modes.label: Other drug-name endings
modes.description: The ending of a drug name such as metformin or the word platinum before a hyphen.
modes.example: who are either metform<<in>> HCl naive or who require a dose
